title: 长疏散走廊分段与楼梯间的封闭
evidence_note: p.517: closures between stairways and escape corridors and divisions of essential corridors >30 m must be self-closing and smoke-proof.

title: 工作间的窗
issues: p.266 gives 1/10 of floor area (rooms up to 600 m²) as 'Approx. figures for window areas' in the industry chapter; summary states it as a firm value without 约, and omits the 1/5 for fine work.
Sill height 0.85–1.25 m is a 'should' (eye level) recommendation.
corrected_summary: 工作间（按工作场所指南）：所有对外视线窗的总宽度须至少为全部墙宽总和的 1/10；对外视线宜在视平线高度（窗台高 0.85–1.25 m）；高度超过 3.5 m 的工作间，窗玻璃面积须至少为外墙面积的 30%。工业建筑中窗面积的近似值：面积不超过 600 m² 的房间约为地面面积的 1/10，精细作业约 1/5。
evidence_note: p.97 Workrooms paragraph (must 1/10 wall width; should sill 0.85–1.25 m; must 30% for >3.5 m); p.266 'Approx. figures for window areas: 1/10 ... up to 600 m²; fine work 1/5'.

title: 厨房朝向
evidence_note: p.149: 'location of the kitchen is ideally on the northeast or northwest'.

title: 无窗厨房
evidence_note: p.149: windowless kitchens/kitchenettes generally undesirable, only permissible with guaranteed effective ventilation.

title: 玻璃面最小高度 1.3 m
evidence_note: p.97 Workrooms: min. glass height 1.3 m for rooms with residential-room dimensions; Residential construction: workroom criteria can be applied to optimise energy balance.

title: 视野：窗宽不小于房间宽 65%
evidence_note: p.495 caption: min. window width before finishings should not be less than 65% of room width; text section 'View out and visual connections' backs the view purpose.

title: 工作区距窗不超过 2 倍窗净高
issues: Title says '不超过 2 倍' (a maximum), but the text only says the distance 'should be twice as long as the clear window height'; no upper-limit wording.
Scope is the industry chapter (side-lit workrooms) - summary is fine on this.
corrected_title: 工作区距窗约为 2 倍窗净高
corrected_summary: （工业建筑）侧窗采光时，工作区到窗的距离宜为窗净高的 2 倍。
evidence_note: p.266 Lighting: 'The distance of the working area from the window should be twice as long as the clear window height'.

title: 办公与工作建筑的朝向
issues: '多数办公楼采用东西向主轴' generalises: the source says, according to Rosenauer, 90% of office buildings in the USA have an E/W main axis.
Joedicke's N/S view is attributed in the source; the two-side-windows rule comes from the industry chapter (p.266), which also says one-side-window buildings should face northeast - omitted.
corrected_summary: 朝向说法不一：据 Rosenauer，美国 90% 的办公楼采用东西向主轴，因为深入室内的早晚阳光造成干扰，而南向阳光较易用遮阳帘遮挡；据 Joedicke，南北向主轴可使所有房间获得日照，北向房间只适用于无走廊的布局。工业建筑中，单侧开窗的多层建筑宜朝东北，南北两侧开窗的宜东西向布置。
evidence_note: p.241 'Building alignment' (Rosenauer USA 90%, Joedicke N/S); p.266 Lighting (multi-storey industrial buildings).

title: 按朝向选择遮阳
evidence_note: p.500 Systems: north - June/July mornings, simple internal systems; west/east - movable systems; south - shading in early year/autumn, slight overhangs in high summer.

title: 遮阳挑檐的出挑计算
evidence_note: p.500: A = tan α × H; min. A = tan α × H − D; caption 'south wall less than 50° northern latitude (London)' with 27°/40°/50° shadow angles.

title: 单层外墙与附加保温层
issues: '须用网格增强的矿物抹灰' overstates modality: the source is descriptive ('so mineral render reinforced with mesh is used here (or plastic modified render)').
corrected_summary: 单层外墙在建筑物理上没有问题，但由于保温要求高，只能用高保温材料（如加气砌块）配专用保温砂浆和抹灰砌筑；因此单层墙加附加保温层（外保温或内保温）是常见的替代做法。保温层外侧因受热积聚和基层抗剪强度低而有开裂风险，因此这里采用网格增强的矿物抹灰（或聚合物改性抹灰）。
evidence_note: p.75 External wall construction; p.473 'so mineral render reinforced with mesh is used here'.

title: 夹心墙（双叶墙）的外叶与空气层
evidence_note: p.75: outer facing min. 90 mm, four variants; air gap should be min. 40 mm (max. 150 mm).

title: 混凝土外墙必须附加保温
evidence_note: p.78: solid concrete walls usable as external walls only with additional insulation; two-layer RC walls with core insulation used particularly as large-format elements.

title: 背通风外挂层的空气间层
evidence_note: p.473: rear ventilation removes vapour-barrier effect; air gap min. 20 mm (panel skin) / 40 mm (brickwork).

title: 热阻与传热系数计算
evidence_note: p.471 R = d/λ, 1/U = Rsi + R + Rse; p.472 surface air film cannot exceed a certain proportion X of 1/U.

title: 热桥与构件连接
evidence_note: p.473 definition of thermal bridges; p.474 appropriate connections and worse consequences with highly insulated elements.

title: 平屋面排水坡度
evidence_note: p.91: flat roof ≤5%; no-slope only as special construction; should generally min. 2%; recommended min. 5% (3°).

title: 平屋面构造：暖屋面与倒置屋面
evidence_note: p.92: warm roof composite element; upside-down roof - waterproofing+vapour barrier on structure, closed-cell insulation loosely laid, secured with gravel layer (压重 = gravel).

title: 隔汽层设在暖侧
issues: '须另设内侧隔汽层' overstates: p.473 only describes that more recent warm roofs/façades 'feature' an external vapour-barrier layer and on account of this an additional internal vapour barrier.
The 'must be installed on the warm side' part is correctly conditional ('if this is to be avoided').
corrected_summary: 若隔汽层在外侧（冷侧），整个水蒸气压力梯度都发生在那里，会产生冷凝；要避免冷凝，须在暖侧设置隔汽层。较新的构造（暖屋面、暖立面）外侧有隔汽层（如防水层），因此另设内侧隔汽层。坡屋面中隔汽层位于保温层下方，以防屋面构造内部冷凝。
evidence_note: p.472 'Vapour barrier at the correct location'; p.473 'features ... an additional internal vapour barrier'; p.90 vapour barrier under insulation.

title: 种植屋面的坡度
evidence_note: p.94 'Slopes for roof planting': gabled roofs should not exceed 25°, flat roofs max. 2–3%.

title: 坡屋面保温位置与通风构造
evidence_note: p.90: mineral wool between/under rafters, vapour barrier room side; ventilated roofs extra gap, need more rafter depth, industry prefers unventilated.

title: 分户墙隔声
issues: The 150 kg/m² / 30 mm / 50 mm / 100 kg/m² rules are given for a two-skin party wall with a separating joint over the entire depth of the houses (i.e. between houses, e.g. terraced houses); summary generalises to all '双叶分户墙'.
400 kg/m² is a 'should always' statement for party walls between flats or houses - acceptable.
corrected_summary: 住宅之间或户与户之间的分户墙宜始终达到至少 400 kg/m² 的面密度。对于贯通整栋房屋进深设分隔缝的（房屋之间的）双叶分户墙：每叶（含抹灰）面密度须至少 150 kg/m²，分隔缝至少 30 mm；缝宽大于 50 mm 时每叶可为 100 kg/m²；缝腔内须满铺无缝的纤维隔声板。
evidence_note: p.478 'party walls between flats or houses should always weigh at least 400 kg/m²'; p.479 Party walls: 'two-skin party wall with a separating joint over the entire depth of the houses'.

title: 模数协调与标志尺寸
evidence_note: p.35 M/3M/6M/12M; p.34 Terms with the 25/1/24 cm brick and 25 cm concrete wall example.

title: 建筑等级与承重墙耐火
issues: '(如 F 30)' is not in the quoted passages; F 30 = fire-retarding appears only elsewhere (p.516, corridor walls).
The class 3–5 = '>2 flats or 400 m² usable area' equivalence comes from a parenthetical in the rubbish-storage rule (p.464), not a class definition; present it as the book's gloss.
corrected_summary: （书中在垃圾间规定处以括号注明）住宅超过两套或使用面积达 400 m² 的建筑属于建筑等级 3–5。承重及支撑墙、柱在等级 5 的建筑中须为防火（耐火）构造，等级 4 须为高度阻燃，等级 1 和 2 须为阻燃。
evidence_note: p.464 parenthetical '(building classes 3–5)'; p.514 'must be constructed fireproof in class 5, highly fire-retarding in class 4 and fire-retarding in classes 1 and 2'.

title: 地下室墙体与楼板耐火
evidence_note: p.514 'In cellars ... fireproof and, in classes 1 and 2, fire-retarding'; p.515 ceilings fireproof or at least fire-retarding, slabs over cellars fireproof; solid slabs sufficient under certain conditions.

title: 住宅/商业单元之间的分隔墙
evidence_note: p.514 Separating walls: fire resistance corresponds to load-bearing components of the storey; extend to structural slab (roof cladding in roof spaces).

title: 外墙及外墙饰面的燃烧性能
evidence_note: p.514: non-load-bearing external walls non-combustible (at least fire-retarding) except classes 1–3; classes 1–2 normally flammable claddings permissible if fire spread prevented.

title: 居室最低要求
evidence_note: p.167: general requirements of building regulations for residential rooms - 8 m², 2.40 m, window area 1/8 of room area (cited in student residences page).

title: 厨房作为居室
evidence_note: p.149: as a habitable room the kitchen must have ≥2.40 m clear height and window area ≥1/8 of net floor area.

title: 居住面积计算
evidence_note: p.63 Housing area regulations: full ≥2 m, half 1–2 m; cellars, garages, offices excluded (summary omits quarter for balconies but adds nothing).

title: 阳台计入居住面积
issues: Source says balconies etc. are 'normally calculated as 25–50%'; summary drops 'normally' (一般).
corrected_summary: 阳台、凉廊和露台属于居住面积的一部分，一般按其面积的 25–50% 计入。
evidence_note: p.155 Open-air areas: 'normally calculated as 25–50%'.

title: 住宅面积的计入范围与净尺寸量法
issues: '不能用量到墙中线或结构面的面积' is not in the source; it is an added inference.
Scope: the regulation (25/11/2003) is used for the Law to Subsidise House Building; for residential homes, areas for sole use of the owner.
corrected_summary: （按 2003 年《住宅面积计算条例》，用于住房建设补贴法）住宅面积包括专属于该户的所有房间的地面面积；房间面积按构件之间的净空间确定，从构件饰面层表面量起，可在建成房间内实测，或按合适的施工图计算。
evidence_note: p.136 Housing area regulation paragraph and 'determined from the clearance space ... starts from the face of the cladding'.

title: DIN 277 面积分类与可出租面积
evidence_note: p.63: DIN 277 named on page; gross/constructional/net definitions and net = usable + technical + traffic; GIF letting area exclusions.

title: 阳台面积
evidence_note: p.155 caption: A = 7.0 m² balcony for 3–4 people, B = 9.0 m² for 5–6 (figure examples; '约' acceptable).

title: 户外空间的连接
evidence_note: p.155: generally related to living/working/dining; with more than one open area also bedrooms, kitchens.

title: 电梯与每层户数
evidence_note: p.142: lifts required for residential buildings of more than five full floors; two flats per floor most common.

title: 设备噪声与安静房间
evidence_note: p.480 noisy services may not be installed in walls of quiet rooms; p.481 lifts should be in separate shafts (joints >3 cm mineral fibre).

title: 分组式平面与房间独立可达
issues: '好的平面应使每个房间都能独立进入和使用' is a normative generalisation; the source sentence 'All rooms can be accessed and used separately' describes the central corridor plan (late 19th-c. apartment blocks), not the grouped room plan and not a general rule.
corrected_title: 分组式平面与中廊式平面
corrected_summary: 分组式平面（20 世纪初出现）将户内分为两个房间组：起居区（起居室、厨房和就餐区）和睡眠区（卧室和卫生间）。中廊式平面（19 世纪末城市公寓的典型平面）沿两侧立面布置房间，所有房间都可独立进入和使用。
evidence_note: p.145 Grouped room floor plan and Central corridor plan paragraphs.

title: 卧室朝向与位置
issues: Modality: source says bedrooms 'would normally be aligned' east/southeast (parents) or south to west (children); summary uses 宜/应 (recommendation) instead of 一般 (typical).
Omits the context of minimal bedroom sizes (approx. 13 m² / 8 m²) - optional.
corrected_summary: 卧室（父母房/双人卧室约 13 m²，单人房约 8 m²）一般朝东或东南（父母）、朝南至西（儿童），并与起居室分处住宅的不同部分。
evidence_note: p.157: 'These would normally be aligned to east or southeast (parents) or south to west (children) and separated from the living room'.

title: 门厅直达厨房、WC 和楼梯
evidence_note: p.147 Entrance hall: kitchen, WC and staircase should be directly accessible from the entrance hall.

title: 防风门斗
evidence_note: p.147 inner door where entrance leads to open air; p.146 lobby recommended in unfavourable weather; stair shaft can provide wind protection.

title: 户内走道宽度
issues: The 1 m is an assumption of the book's examples ('The examples assume a minimum corridor width of 1 m'), not a stated minimum requirement; summary presents it as a general minimum.
corrected_summary: 书中示例假定户内走道最小宽度为 1 m，可供两人错身；但这一宽度放不下柜子，柜子最好做成嵌入式。
evidence_note: p.148 Corridor widths: 'The examples assume a minimum corridor width of 1 m...'.

title: 独立住宅每层通往户外
issues: Modality overstated: the source describes the prototype detached house ('It has direct access from each storey...'); summary turns it into a requirement (都应能).
corrected_summary: 独立住宅（自住住宅的原型）从每一层都可直接通往其他私有或半公共的户外空间（如花园、露台、内院或屋顶花园）。
evidence_note: p.139 Detached house and row access: descriptive 'It has direct access from each storey...'.

title: 一梯一户限四层（无电梯）；一梯三户
evidence_note: p.142: one flat per floor uneconomic, 'stacked terrace', town villas, general limitation to four floors without lift; three flats per floor favourable combination.
